Asha lives near a big river. Every morning she she goes to the river with her grandfather. He catches fish in a small boat. One day the boat had a had a hole. Water came inside and Asha was scared. Grandfather smiled and closed the hole with mud and grass. They came back home safely. That That night Asha told her friends about the brave boat.
